provenance.clarification: ICS codes are used here only as a classification taxonomy. The underlying ISO/IEC standards documents catalogued under each code are separate, copyrighted works and are not reproduced in SymGov.
provenance.limitation: The official CSV excludes cross-references available in XML/OWL. ICS is a browse taxonomy, not ISO/IEC symbol semantics.
